name: Partner halo grows a revenue counter
looks: A headline names a claim about growth through others. A loose scatter of small round avatar bubbles fills the frame around a single glowing hub mark at the centre, no lines between them, just proximity and glow. A dollar figure beneath climbs from one value to a noticeably larger one.
build: avatar-network-halo: the bubbles populate on a loose overlapping stagger around the hub; the dollar value uses data-infographic's roll-up, timed to land just after the bubbles settle, then ticks up again to a second, larger figure.
sound: A soft shimmer as the bubbles populate, and a rising tone under each counter climb.
prompt: Prove a network effect pays off: scatter a loose cloud of small avatar bubbles around one glowing central hub, no connecting lines needed, and grow a dollar or count value beneath it from one figure to a clearly larger one, so the claim is seen compounding.
